svg.title: The two-source lattice and its shared-exclusion events
svg.desc: The four nodes of the two-source redundancy lattice, the event of each node at an observed row, and how atoms follow from cumulative values by Möbius inversion.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: THE TWO-SOURCE LATTICE AND ITS SHARED-EXCLUSION EVENTS
Each node names groups of sources. Its
event, at an observed row, is an OR over
the groups of an AND inside each group.
An arrow points from a weaker event to a
Each node has a cumulative value c. Its
atom is c minus the atoms below it; the
four atoms add up to I(S1, S2; T).
Lattice: Williams and Beer (2010). Events: shared exclusions of Makkeh, Gutknecht and Wibral (2021); the order is logical implication.
